scenes.text: Myth or fact? You should tip in Korea.
Tipping isn't part of the culture. Not in restaurants, not in taxis. Leaving money can even confuse people.
scenes.head: Tipping isn't expected.

caption:
Should you tip in Korea? Myth. 💸
Tipping isn't part of the culture, in restaurants or taxis, and it can even confuse staff. Pay the bill and say 감사합니다.
Send this to whoever's coming to Korea with you.
